name: cortico managed pointer
coordinates: relative to the hotspot (arrow tip); x grows right, y grows down; one unit is one client pixel

companion.note: drawOffset in sprite/companion.json; the companion sits at the arrow's lower-right and follows the animation frame of the current state

edgeFlip: when the hotspot is within offset + width + motionExtent of the right client edge, x offsets flip sign; same for y at the bottom edge
